CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.apple_consent_user_is_revoked(p_user_id uuid, p_environment text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists(select 1 from flapfit_private.apple_consent_identities i
    join flapfit_private.apple_consent_revocations r using (transaction_hash)
    where i.user_id = p_user_id and r.environment = p_environment);
$function$

functions.arguments: p_user_id uuid, p_kind text, p_exercise text, p_challenge_code text, p_rules_version text

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cleanup_flapfit_retention()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  delete from public.game_runs
  where expires_at < pg_catalog.now() - interval '7 days';

  delete from public.challenges
  where expires_at < pg_catalog.now();

  delete from public.content_reports
  where status in ('reviewed', 'actioned', 'dismissed')
    and resolved_at < pg_catalog.now() - interval '180 days';
end;
$function$

functions.arguments: p_run_id uuid, p_user_id uuid, p_player_name text, p_score integer, p_duration_ms integer, p_terms_version text, p_rules_version text
